director.name: 尚杰·佩鲁马尔 Sun-J Perumal

introduction: It is said that Nature is speaking to us, but how many are listening? SATORI, a creative documentary of pure Sight and Sound has 5 elements of nature (Land/Sky/Fire/Water/Air), accompanied by various unique audio, meant to evoke different emotions to different viewers. In today's multi-tasking life, the act of just observing nature has become an anomaly. Sages, prophets, philosophers and spiritual leaders of different eras were known to have achieved enlightenment through being at one with nature, and by witnessing nature's movement for hours and even for days. Through this film, we would like to bring nature to people, forcing them to sit and watch and to experience the connection within themselves. There will be a spiritual quote before the video of each element.
